# `vl completions`

Print a shell completion script, e.g. `vl completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_vl`

```text
vl completions [OPTIONS] <SHELL>
```

Arguments:

| | |
|---|---|
| `<SHELL>` | Shell to generate the script for (required; one of `bash`, `elvish`, `fish`, `powershell`, `zsh`) |
